title: Acyclicity of the gate list
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb{N}$ with $k\le n$, and let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$. In the gate list constructed from $f$ and $k$, every gate at index $i$ has all its input vertices indexed below $n+i$.
